cuts.cap: HoloTable · combat demo · a cantina in Mos Shuuta
Exploring: fog of war — each player sees only what their own character can see
Walls and a parked shuttle marked “Blocks sight” hide the back room. The bounty hunter's name is hidden: “???”
Talks go wrong. The GM starts combat: queued “⚔ when combat starts” moves play
Everyone rolls initiative; the GM's tracker rates the fight
Kira's turn: the squares she can reach light up; moving counts down her feet
She closes in and strikes with her lightsaber: the server rolls, damage floats up
End turn. The hunter breaks away — Kira gets an opportunity attack prompt
The GM runs the creature: its attacks come from its SW5e stat block
Rex's turn: class resources — Second Wind and Action Surge are tracked uses
The sniper takes aim at Kira… and she drops to 0 HP
Unseen: the guard in the back room acts — only the GM's chat shows it (chat follows sight)
Round 2, Kira's turn: at 0 HP she rolls a death saving throw
The GM ends combat; the table goes back to exploring
Assets: SW Bendu & Stalitz, Echoes, Primal and Mos Shuuta props by Maveritchell (P. Thompson)
